title: Footwork Drills (Michelle Grogan)
style: Latin-infused pop and funk fusion. Features a prominent brass section with trumpets and trombones playing syncopated staccato stabs. A clean, rhythmic electric guitar plays muted sixteenth-note scratches and funk chords. The bass guitar follows a driving, syncopated Latin-pop pattern. Percussion includes a full drum kit with a crisp snare, cowbell, and handclaps on the backbeat. Male lead vocals are energetic and rhythmic, supported by group backing vocals in a call-and-response style. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of G major. The arrangement uses frequent stop-time breaks and rhythmic unisons between the vocals and the brass section.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[brass stabs, funk guitar, cowbell, driving drums]
Footwork! [claps]
Is the foundation
No good shot without good feet
[bass enters]
Split step, shuffle, slide
Ready stance, always ready (brrrr)

[Verse 1]
Split step on every contact there [brass accents]
Small hop two inches above the ground
Land soft on the toes, ready
Feet apart, shoulder-width found
¡Vamos, vamos! Feed the light
Uno, dos, tres, feet drive
Shuffle side to side, now go cross
Split step for governor loss

[Chorus]
Split and step and slide and shuffle
Split and step, no more struggle
Footwork drills, footwork drills
Split step, shuffle, slide
Split step, shuffle, slide
Footwork drills, footwork drills
¡Vamos amigos! Move with pride

[Verse 2]
Ladder drill, ten minutes a day
In, out, in, out, side to side stay
Cone drill, four cones in a square
Shuffle around, no air, no air
Uno, dos, tres, ladder feet
Mano firme, shuffle beat
Knee drive, every step out
Ready stance, no doubt

[Bridge]
[music strips back to drums and bass]
The legs are the engine of every shot
Weak feet, weak shot, we forgot
Ten minutes a day on the ladder drill
Three weeks later, you might have the skill

[Chorus]
Footwork drills, footwork drills
Split step, shuffle, slide
Split step, shuffle, slide
Footwork drills, footwork drills
¡Vamos amigos! Move with pride
Split, step, slide, and shuffle
Split, step, feet do the hustle
[final brass flourish]
